schema.description: Set true ONLY for a level the user supplied for this option and factor, with its actual source; the host must verify that source before recording it as theirs. A verified retained human statement counts. Set false ONLY when explicitly proposing a new Olumi estimate now, with its own basis. Never infer false from missing, truncated or unmatched source, or from the absence of a user-authorship claim. Do not use false to relabel an old quoted, copied or recorded figure. Keep the original statement, subject and qualifications separate from any new interpretation. This flag is a claim to check, not proof of authorship; accepting an Olumi estimate does not turn it into a user-supplied fact. On an option in `status_quo_held`, a level is permitted only with true and verified user words saying that carrying on changes this factor and giving that level. Never restate the factor's starting value: carrying on as now already keeps that, so such a level is not recorded.

assumption_basis_line: Olumi's proposed basis for this estimate (any claimed earlier statement remains unverified unless shown with its verified source): “{basis}”
card_scope: Show the complete verbatim basis per model_proposed assumption beside its factor, value and unit on the actual approval card, including the combined starting-point card, before bound approval. Do not label a verified human figure with this line. A kept canonical Olumi estimate remains a retained estimate, not a newly authored figure. Preserve original statements, subjects, qualifications and source status separately; no missing basis, summary-only consent or truncation to remove material qualifications.
source_limit: The basis line makes the proposed basis visible; it does not verify an earlier-source claim or establish that a copied old figure is a genuinely new estimate. False plus 'From your earlier note...' must retain that original unverified statement separately and require an actual new Olumi estimate with its own basis; existing verified/tier-2/unknown guards remain. No phrase-list parser or marker-only provenance closure.
B3_disposition: The existing disclosed exact-start scenario route (b) is within the prior AIE science disposition only as a new Olumi modelling assumption on the complete bound approval card. Equality with an opposite AI endpoint does not make the human one-sided bound an exact forecast or establish a distribution. Preserve the full original bound, subject, reference, qualifications and rate/quality/period conditions; keep the compatible opposite endpoint labelled Olumi's. This is scoped source support, not final-head/provider/served acceptance or durable A2j closure.
implementation_scope: Replace both obsolete user_stated descriptions once and add the required Boolean at both existing option-level item sites; preserve the existing schema shapes, ranges, status_quo_held restrictions, shared caller forwarding, native units and permission/revision/write checks. Add the basis face through the existing card carrier actually read by the UI. No new tool, parser, store, writer, API, model call or generic wording gate.
proof_limit: Exact text/schema/card-copy handback only. Original fresh-review FAIL and five blockers remain banked. Existing owner/checker/operator proves actual amended immutable assembly and reached request bodies, verified-human/new-AI/missing/unverifiable/tier-2/status-quo-held contrasts and full visible approval/readback. No test/scorer/gold change or provider-quality/CI/serving/manual readiness claim.
